title: Your Christmas or Mine 2
description: Your Christmas or Mine 2 is a 2023 British Christmas romantic comedy film directed by Jim O'Hanlon from a screenplay by Tom Parry. It is a sequel to Your Christmas or Mine? (2022) and stars Asa Butterfield and Cora Kirk as a couple whose two families, after a mix-up with transport at Innsbruck Airport, end up at each other's holiday accommodation on different sides of a valley. Daniel Mays, Angela Griffin, David Bradley, Natalie Gumede, Alex Jennings, Jane Krakowski, and Rhea Norwood also appear in supporting roles.
